interaction.prompt: You have the puck in the corner. True or False: the half-wall teammate above you has a clean passing lane right now. Tap the zone you would actually pass to.

feedback.right: False — good read. X1 is parked directly in the lane from your corner to the half-wall, cutting off that pass. The LW drifting into the slot has a clear route.
feedback.wrong: Look at X1 before you commit — that defender sits right in the corner-to-half-wall lane and intercepts it. The slot is the clean outlet here.

tip: Trace the full lane before you pass, not just the distance. A defender two strides off the boards can still cut off a short wall pass.
why: X1 closes the corner-to-half-wall lane. The slot LW is uncontested from this angle, making it the only safe release.

read.cue: X1 stands in the direct lane from the corner to the half-wall teammate
